1.title: The Hungry Cat
1.content: The cat is hungry. It wants to eat fish. The cat goes to the kitchen.

1.title: The Happy Dog
1.content: The dog is happy. It plays with a ball. The dog runs in the park.

1.title: The Big Elephant
1.content: The elephant is big. It lives in the jungle. The elephant likes water.

2.title: The Red Balloon
2.content: Leo has a red balloon. It flies in the blue sky. Leo is very happy.

2.title: The Rainbow
2.content: After the rain, a rainbow appears. It has red, yellow, green and purple colors.

3.title: Breakfast Time
3.content: Leo eats bread and drinks milk. Then he eats a red apple. Breakfast is yummy!

3.title: Pizza Party
3.content: It is Leo's birthday. His friends bring pizza and cake. Everyone is happy!

4.title: My Family
4.content: This is my mother and my father. I have one sister and one brother. We love our house.

4.title: Bedtime
4.content: Leo opens the window. He closes the door. Leo goes to bed and says good night.

5.title: First Day of School
5.content: Leo goes to school with his book and pencil. He meets a new friend. The teacher smiles.

5.title: Counting Friends
5.content: Leo has one, two, three friends at school. They read books together.
